title: RelaySignal
description: Types the causal signal propagated through a Relay Interaction from one mechanism to the next within an operation chain. The body carries the causal content that triggers the downstream mechanism's activation. At protocol level, unconstrained; extending archetypes constrain it to a domain-specific shape via $ref/allOf composition.

body.description: Causal signal content. At protocol level, unconstrained; extending archetypes constrain this to a domain-specific shape via $ref/allOf composition.
